name: pdf-phoenix
description: PDF viewer and annotator for VS Code. Save highlights and notes into the file, export them to Markdown, move them between PDFs and tools as XFDF, read in your theme's colors, and pick up where you left off, on a self-updating, verified Mozilla pdf.js engine.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, JavaScript embedded in PDFs (used by some interactive forms) does not run. Viewing, annotating, and saving work as usual.

pdfPhoenix.rememberViewState.markdownDescription: Reopen each PDF where you left off: page, zoom, scroll position, rotation, sidebar panel, and scroll/spread mode. Remembered per workspace for the 200 most recently viewed PDFs. The `defaultZoom`, `defaultSidebar`, `defaultScrollMode` and `defaultSpreadMode` settings then apply to PDFs you haven't opened before.

enumDescriptions: Automatic zoom (pdf.js chooses)
Fit the whole page in the view
Fit the page width to the view
Show the page at its actual size (100%)
pdfPhoenix.defaultZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom level a PDF opens at. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

enumDescriptions: Start with the sidebar closed
Start with the page thumbnails panel open
Start with the document outline (bookmarks) panel open, falling back to thumbnails when the PDF has no outline
pdfPhoenix.defaultSidebar.markdownDescription: Which sidebar panel a PDF opens with. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

enumDescriptions: Use the layout the PDF asks for, otherwise scroll vertically
Scroll through pages vertically
Scroll through pages horizontally
Wrap pages into rows, like a grid
Show one page (or spread) at a time
pdfPhoenix.defaultScrollMode.markdownDescription: How pages are laid out for scrolling when a PDF opens. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

enumDescriptions: Use the layout the PDF asks for, otherwise single pages
Single pages
Two pages side by side, starting with odd-numbered pages (like a book with its cover on its own)
Two pages side by side, starting with even-numbered pages
pdfPhoenix.defaultSpreadMode.markdownDescription: Whether pages are shown singly or as two-page spreads when a PDF opens. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

enumDescriptions: Select text with the pointer
Drag pages around with the pointer (hand tool)
pdfPhoenix.defaultCursorTool.markdownDescription: The pointer tool a PDF opens with. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

enumDescriptions: Use a light or dark viewer to match the current VS Code theme
Always use the light viewer
Always use the dark viewer
pdfPhoenix.viewerTheme.markdownDescription: Color scheme of the viewer's toolbar, sidebar, and dialogs. Follows VS Code theme changes live.

enumDescriptions: Show pages in the document's own colors
Recolor pages to the editor's background and text colors while VS Code uses a dark theme
Recolor pages to the editor's background and text colors in every theme
pdfPhoenix.pageColors.markdownDescription: Recolor page content to match the VS Code editor. Recolored pages are drawn in two tones between the editor's text and background colors, so images lose their color. Display only: saved annotations keep the colors you chose. Open PDFs reload to pick up a change (keeping your place), or wait until you save or revert if they have unsaved changes.

pdfPhoenix.annotations.highlightColor.markdownDescription: Color the highlight tool starts with. You can still pick another color for each highlight. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

pdfPhoenix.annotations.inkColor.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex color such as #1E90FF.
pdfPhoenix.annotations.inkColor.markdownDescription: Color the draw (ink) tool starts with, as a hex color such as `#1E90FF`. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

pdfPhoenix.annotations.inkThickness.markdownDescription: Line thickness the draw (ink) tool starts with, from 1 to 20. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

pdfPhoenix.annotations.textColor.patternErrorMessage: Use a hex color such as #1E90FF.
pdfPhoenix.annotations.textColor.markdownDescription: Text color the text tool starts with, as a hex color such as `#1E90FF`. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

pdfPhoenix.annotations.textSize.markdownDescription: Font size the text tool starts with, from 5 to 100. Applies to PDFs you open after changing this.

pdfPhoenix.pdfjs.autoCheckForUpdates.markdownDescription: Check about once a day for a newer pdf.js release within the current major version, and ask before downloading it. Major-version upgrades are never installed automatically; use the "PDF Phoenix: Choose pdf.js Version…" command for those.

pdfPhoenix.pdfjs.keepDownloadedVersion.markdownDescription: Keep using the pdf.js version you downloaded or chose, even after a PDF Phoenix update brings a built-in version that is the same or newer. When off, the newer built-in version takes over and the old download is removed. To stay on one version, also turn off `#pdfPhoenix.pdfjs.autoCheckForUpdates#`.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
